coreModelUse: Keep destination rewriting and allow/deny as separate decisions throughout the trace and check.

sections.why: Translation and permission need separate columns, not a single vague shield.
Compare outbound reply, unsolicited IPv4, forwarded IPv4 and native IPv6 without confusing address family with policy.
Linear flow models a packet through policy and destination, while spatial reach is stated in words.
Explain that both router and host decisions and an actual listener matter.
Transfer the distinction to IPv6 rather than memorizing NAT defaults.
List unknowns in a private read-only configuration check.
RFCs and FTC guidance support the policy and IPv6 distinction.

rejected.why: Firewall configuration commands are the next page's job; this page explains the model, so commands would teach a change the page deliberately excludes.
